# Optional values

<!-- GENERATED by docsgen/gen_as_api.py from

Import from `"rive/box"`. Declares: `Box`, `Box_Mat2D`, `Box_Vector`

```as
/// A class that holds one value, so a value that cannot be null on its own can
/// be optional. Numbers, booleans and structs are never null, so an optional
/// one is written `Box<T>?`: `null` means no value.
///
/// Structs cannot be generic arguments, so use `Box_Vector` and `Box_Mat2D` for
/// `Vector` and `Mat2D`.
/// ```as
/// import { Box } from "rive/box";
///
/// function half(value: f64): Box<f64>? {
///   return value > 0 ? new Box<f64>(value / 2) : null;
/// }
///
/// export function describe(value: f64): string {
///   return half(value)?.value.toString() ?? "none";
/// }
/// ```
export class Box<T> {
    /// The held value.
    value: T;

    /// Creates a box holding `value`.
    constructor(value: T);
}

/// A `Box` for a `Vector`, so an optional vector can be written
/// `Box_Vector?`.
export class Box_Vector {
    /// The held vector.
    value: Vector;

    /// Creates a box holding `value`.
    constructor(value: Vector);
}

/// A `Box` for a `Mat2D`, so an optional matrix can be written
/// `Box_Mat2D?`.
export class Box_Mat2D {
    /// The held matrix.
    value: Mat2D;

    /// Creates a box holding `value`.
    constructor(value: Mat2D);
}
